# ScreenCraft
> Free, privacy-first screenshot and screen recording mockup editor. Runs 100% in the browser.

## What it does
ScreenCraft turns raw screenshots and screen recordings into polished, professional visuals. Upload or paste a screenshot, add a browser or device frame, pick a background, and download a high-resolution PNG or export a beautified video — all without uploading anything to a server.

## Features
- macOS-style browser frame, desktop frame, and smartphone device frame
- Solid color, gradient, and blurred backgrounds
- Customizable padding, corner radius, and shadow
- Canvas presets for Chrome Web Store, Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Dribbble, Product Hunt
- High-DPI PNG export at 1x, 2x, or 3x scale
- Clipboard copy (one click to paste into Slack, Notion, Figma, or social media)
- Clipboard paste import (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V from system screenshot tools)
- MP4 and WebM video beautification and export
- Video playback controls (play, pause, scrub, mute, loop)
- Single-frame capture from video recordings
- Progressive Web App with offline support

## URL
https://screen-craft.vercel.app/

## Privacy
All image and video processing happens client-side in the browser. No files are uploaded to any server. No account or signup required. Optional analytics records app events only, never files or filenames.

## Tech Stack
React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, HTML Canvas API, MediaRecorder API
